messages:
maria: heads-up — saw a perf/regression on canary for mixtral-8x7b around the new fused-attn kernel + RoPE scaling tweak. KV cache peak and eviction rate both up.
chen: ugh, when did this land to canary? any repro steps?
maria: canary rolled ~2h ago (deploy-bot posted). repro: long-prefix chat workload, ctx=2048, steady-state after ~200 tokens. quick profile snippet below.
maria: ```
profile_summary: {
  model: mixtral-8x7b,
  kernel: fused_attn_v2,
  peak_kv_bytes: 12.1GB -> 13.5GB (+11.6%),
  eviction_events: 148 -> 210 (+41%),
  tail_latency_p95: 78ms -> 95ms
}
router_log: chose fused_attn_v2 for seq_len=2048, falling back to kv_copy_fp16 path for prefetched prefixes
```
samir: interesting — fused_attn avoids extra attention passes but we added a `kv_copy` path when RoPE scale changed to support rotary interpolation. that copy is inflating transient memory.
eva: is this only mixtral? or qwen/llama also hit it?
maria: confirmed on mixtral and qwen-7b; llama-2 configs less affected because their head_dim is smaller so kv footprint diff is smaller.
chen: can you paste the minimal repro? i'll run a microbench locally.
maria: repro cURL:```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-infer/internal/predict 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"mixtral-8x7b","max_tokens":1024,"input":"<long prefix>"}'
```
oom-bot: ALERT: eviction_count > threshold for mixtral-8x7b on canary (instance gpu-12).
samir: quick idea — update kernel_router to prefer `separate_attn` when estimated_kv_bytes > K_THRESHOLD to avoid the `kv_copy` fallback. separate_attn is slower compute-wise but avoids the extra mem transient. tradeoff: latency vs OOM.
eva: alternatively we can try quantized prefix cache (8-bit) for prefetched KV only. i ran a small run last month: quant-KV reduced mem 18% but introduced ~0.15 ppl bump on our eval set. might be acceptable for long-prefix chat.
chen: i'll run a control: (1) current canary, (2) router-prefers-separate-attn patch, (3) quantized-prefetch-kv. will report peak mem, evictions, p95 latency and eval-quality.
maria: thanks. also add an experiment to flip RoPE scaling back to previous interpolation (just for canary) to see delta. i suspect the ropetweak changed alignment and triggered extra prefetch of prefixes.
ops: note: dedicated customers with pinned models shouldn't be impacted, this was a canary-only kernel selection change. but we should be conservative.
deploy-bot: canary rollout for fused-attn v1.3 happened 2h ago by @release.
samir: i'll prototype a small router patch and push as a feature-flag so we can toggle in canary. simple heuristic: if est_kv_bytes > 11GB and seq_len>1024 -> prefer separate_attn.
eva: i'll spin up an eval job comparing quant-KV vs baseline on our prompt-set (eval-id: quantpref-2026-03-17).
maria: action items: chen run microbench + perf traces; samir proto router flag; eva run quant eval; i'll collect and correlate traces and prep rollback if needed.
chen: starting microbench now, will post results here in ~30m.
ops: thumbs — please tag me if you need emergency rollback.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup: we'll triage in the 11:15 stand if anything surprising shows up.
